Post 1

📈 ASX 200 crossed its 200-day moving average Wednesday, closing at 8,831.30 (+0.16%). But the real story: NXT cratered 41.72% while the index barely flinched. Breadth held the line. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

Telcos led at +2.23%, Industrials +0.99%, Financials +0.96%. IT dragged hardest at -3.32%, weighed down by NXT's collapse. Materials slipped 1.04%. Rotation into defensives and yield is the clear theme. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3

🔻 NEXTDC fell AUD 3.83 to AUD 5.35, a 41.72% single-session wipeout. That is not a typo. When a data centre name drops that hard, the whole growth-infrastructure trade gets repriced fast. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,885.44/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7019. Silver AUD 81.66/oz, Platinum AUD 2,322.69/oz. Metals firm but Materials sector still fell 1.04% — stock-specific pain, not commodity weakness. #gold #ASX

Post 5

8,831 is now the line. ASX held above the 200-day MA today — the question is whether it stays there. Watch US tech overnight given local IT fell 3.32%. Does the index defend this level or fade? #ASX #ausbiz
